name: AI codebase reader
author: Brett
description: Reads allowed GitHub repos read-only through an AI session on axHub (mode ai.read-codebase; the session reads the repo server-side, the plugin sends the request and parses the JSON reply) into notes: architecture and changes since the last read (keyed by the last commit sha), with CodeLinks {repo, path, lineStart, lineEnd, commit} that open on GitHub. Harvests TODO/FIXME comments into one to-do list per repo (stable ids from repo + path + text, deduped, closed when the line disappears). Voice phrases as triggers@1 data: "note on <file>" attaches a note to a file/line, "ask about <file>" asks Claude about that code with the file's notes as context. Settings: allowed repos, TODO harvest, schedule (placeholder).

keeps: Notes it wrote (architecture, changes, answers, notes on files; category Codebase, tag codebase) stay yours. Its per-repo TODO lists (ids starting ai-codebase-reader.) are removed by its Remove plugin data setting.

placeholders.schedule: repos are read on request until a work@1 job host runs the read on a schedule

hostActions.axnotes.notes.save: the app saves a note from payload {id?, title, text, tags[], source, category?, codeLinks[]?}: with id it creates or updates that note (architecture / changes notes keep their id across reads)
hostActions.axnotes.notes.saved: watched: notes with codeLinks are remembered as context for "ask about <file>"
hostActions.axnotes.todos.sync: the app applies {list: {id, name, kind}, owner, add[], update[], close[], reopen[]} to a generated to-do list (made when missing); items are the app's to-do JSON; the user's own items are never touched
hostActions.axnotes.lists.delete: the app deletes a list by {id} (Remove plugin data removes its generated TODO lists)
